title: Annual Conference of Pathology 2025
html:
Save the date!

Our Annual Conference of Pathology is scheduled for 13-14 of November, at our Institute. As usual, we welcome pathology presentations with exciting cases and news from all medical fields. Our research sessions will invite research fellows to discuss their progress in cellular biology, tumor immunology, cancer models and more!

We will be back soon with more information on program, registration and satellite events.
